from pydantic.fields import ModelField

# Monkey patch to add debug info
original_type_analysis = ModelField._type_analysis

def debug_type_analysis(self):
    print(f"\n[_type_analysis] Processing {self.name}: {self.type_}")
    print(f"  Origin: {getattr(self.type_, '__origin__', 'NO ORIGIN')}")
    try:
        from pydantic.typing import get_args, get_origin
        print(f"  Args: {get_args(self.type_)}")
    except:
        print("  Args: ERROR GETTING ARGS")
    
    try:
        result = original_type_analysis(self)
        print(f"[_type_analysis] Finished {self.name}: type_={self.type_}, shape={self.shape}")
        return result
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[_type_analysis] ERROR in {self.name}: {e}")
        print(f"  type_ was: {self.type_}")
        raise

ModelField._type_analysis = debug_type_analysis
